data.heading: Set up Claude once, so every new chat already knows your work

data.image_alt: The Claude Operator's Manual by Elvin M. Peters
data.body:
This Manual shows you how to stop re-explaining who you are and what you do in every new chat. It covers Claude only: it does not cover ChatGPT or other tools. It is a separate $27 charge, and your book order stays as it is.

Inside you will find:

  • Setup in the Claude app, with no coding. Talking to Claude well, Projects and knowledge files, Skills, and connecting your tools.
  • Claude Code, when you are ready. The Claude Code chapters are optional, and they are the only ones that ask you to open a terminal.
  • Workflows to copy. The last part puts the setup together, with a chapter of complete workflows to copy and a chapter on keeping your setup working.
  • Checklists. Every chapter ends with one, and the appendices include a day-one setup checklist.

It is a PDF with 19 chapters. Prices are in US dollars.

Read the contents page and Chapter 3 first (14-page PDF)

What The AI Setup Bundle holds
  • The Claude Operator’s Manual
  • Your Personal Specialists
  • Rules of Engagement

data.small:
Where a detail changes from one release to the next, the Manual explains the idea and points you to the official documentation for the current specifics.

The Claude Operator’s Manual is an independent guide. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Anthropic. Claude is a product of Anthropic, and the name is used only to say what the guide covers.

Elvin Peters, author of The Artificial Advantage
